user_bio: I work at VNTANA, a 3D Product Digital Asset Management platform that turns the CAD files manufacturers already own into interactive product pages, 3D parts catalogs, and product imagery. I build n8n workflows that connect that 3D pipeline to the rest of the stack, so publishing an asset can trigger everything downstream: team notifications, AI rendering, auto-tagging, and syndication to commerce and PIM systems. Every template I share here is an automation we've actually run in production.
